The SOLO flight of the F45XX Section can be executed the same or next day of the last dual formation flight.

text_rules.verbatim: The first SOLO flight can be executed at the F4501, adhering to BD 3-1/HATC restrictions.

The last sortie of each Category of Training Exercises (Contact – Instruments – Formation and Navigation) stands as an evaluation and constitutes the final examination for these categories. The sorties in question are: C5490, I4890, F4690 and Ν4690.

No SP shall begin training in a Training Section or Exercise if he/she has not previously attended and successfully been evaluated upon the objects of ground training, as they appear in the Training Flow Chart.

flags: NO DASHED ARROWS in the Formation chart: all 34 printed arrows on PDF p.17-18 (29 sortie-to-sortie + 5 to/from ground blocks) are solid, verified at 6x zoom on each arrowhead. Arrowhead tally: 24 on p.17 + 11 on p.18 = 35 heads, i.e. 34 logical arrows because the page-break connector F 4305 -> F 4306 prints one stub per page. Every shaft measured as a single uninterrupted dark run (continuity 1.000 along the shaft), including the 5 ground arrows. Dashed styling appears only on the OUTLINE of the C 5201 box. (Contrast: the Instrument chart on PDF p.16 does use dashed arrows, e.g. I 3601 to I 4701.)

CROSS-CATEGORY BOXES printed inside the Formation chart: C 5201 (dashed double outline, center column, PDF p.17), C 2501 and C 2502 (bold single simulator outline, right column, PDF p.17). They are kept as sortie records per rule 1 and tagged cross_category:'Contact'; expect them to also appear in contact.json.

CONFLICT chart vs text: the chart prints the arrow F 3102 -> C 5201 (arrowhead verified on the right edge of C 5201, PDF p.17), i.e. C 5201 is placed AFTER the F31XX simulators. PART III F31XX RESTRICTIONS (1), PDF p.157, states the opposite: 'C5201 must have been executed before starting this Training Section.' BOTH are recorded: the printed arrow as edge F3102->C5201 (kind feed) and the text rule as edge C5201->F3101 (kind prereq).

SOURCE TYPO: the Formation mission table in PART IV (PDF p.207, printed -199-) lists the final checkride as 'F4790'. The chart (PDF p.18), the section page (PDF p.221, 'TRAINING SECTION: F4690 ... Final Formation Checkride') and General Directives d. (PDF p.101) all give F4690. F4690 used here.

SOLO CANDIDATES (green double outline), verified pixel-wise (~15.6k-16.8k pure-green border pixels each): F 4301, F 4302, F 4303, F 4304, F 4305 (section F43XX) and F 4501, F 4502 (section F45XX) = 7 boxes. F 4306 and F 4503 are NOT green (0 green pixels), i.e. the last sortie of each of those two sections is not a solo candidate. Section totals confirm 2 SOLO in F43XX and 1 SOLO in F45XX, so green = 'may be flown SOLO', not 'is SOLO'.

NO NIGHT SORTIES in Formation: no red-text box exists on PDF p.17-18 (0 red pixels in every box), whereas the Instrument chart marks night sorties with red text (I 3601, I 4701 on PDF p.16). No Formation section page mentions night conditions.
ORANGE FILL boxes on the Formation pages: F 4690 (final checkride, sortie), FO 190 and TACFOR 590 (ground written exams -> recorded in ground_entry_points, not as sorties).

FO 101-104 -> FO 190 and TACFOR 501-506 -> TACFOR 590 are printed arrows between two GROUND boxes; they are recorded in ground_entry_points with 'to' pointing at the exam box rather than at a sortie (marked with a note).
PAGE-BREAK CONNECTOR p.17 -> p.18 is SOLID (solid down-arrow out of F 4305 at the foot of PDF p.17, solid down-arrow into F 4306 at the head of PDF p.18); recorded as the single edge F4305 -> F4306.
F 3201 has NO incoming arrow in the chart (the F32XX simulator chain starts unconnected, printed level with F 4201). Likewise C 2501 has no incoming arrow. Not invented.
OUTGOING CROSS-REFERENCE (recorded in the Navigation chart, not here): F 4401 is printed as a dashed cross-category box on PDF p.19 feeding N 4401.

COLUMN VOCABULARY aligned with the rest of flowchart_v2: this file previously used column 'main'/'fs_right' while instrument.json and vfr_navigation.json use 'center'/'right' for the very same two columns. Renamed here to 'center'/'right' (23 center + 7 right) so a renderer needs one vocabulary. The printed left-to-right order is unchanged and stays correct; only the labels moved. STILL OPEN across the generation, not fixable from this file: (a) contact.json carries neither 'column' nor 'box_style'; (b) the box_style vocabulary is still split - this file uses double_thin / bold_single / dashed_double / green_double / orange_fill (keys mirrored in legend_observed), whereas instrument.json and vfr_navigation.json use double_outline_black / thick_solid_black / orange_fill_black_border and have no green value at all, because only Formation prints green solo-candidate outlines.

SECTION CODES: the syllabus prints them with Greek capital chi, e.g. 'F41XX' appears as 'F41ΧΧ'. Normalized to Latin 'X' in the 'section' field. Sortie ids drop the printed space ('F 4101' -> 'F4101'); label_verbatim keeps it. NORMALIZATION BOUNDARY: this Latinization applies ONLY to the derived 'id' and 'section' fields. Every 'verbatim' field reproduces the printed characters exactly, including Greek capitals that the source mixes into Latin codes (e.g. 'Ν4690' in GENERAL DIRECTIVES d. uses Greek capital nu U+039D, not Latin 'N') and en dashes U+2013 (e.g. 'Contact – Instruments – Formation and Navigation'). The single exception is soft de-hyphenation of words broken across printed lines ('BD 3-\n1/HATC' -> 'BD 3-1/HATC').

The chart BODY has no text layer: each flow-chart page embeds a single raster image (p.17: 933x1214 px, p.18: 920x1257 px) holding every box and arrow. The pages are not raster-only, though - the page number and the section title are live text (p.17 text layer: '-9-', '(3)', 'FORMATION'; p.18: '-10-'), and chart_title_verbatim is taken from it. All boxes, arrows, arrowhead directions, outline styles and colours were read from 6x PyMuPDF renders of PDF pages 17-18 plus numeric pixel checks; box inventory independently confirmed by horizontal-edge detection per column (p.17 center column 14 boxes, right column 7 boxes, left/ground column 3 boxes; p.18 center column 9 boxes, left/ground column 2 boxes).
